SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices and delivers them ready to use across Warangal. We build each unit to order at our own ISO-certified factory and dispatch it fitted â€” walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done â€” to the Kakatiya Mega Textile Park, the Hanamkonda industrial pockets and project sites across the district. You deal with the maker, not a reseller or a marketplace listing. For models, sizes and finishes, see our full Container Office Manufacturer for Kakatiya Textile Park range, then send your requirement for a quote.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. Because it arrives finished, your team can move in the day it lands â€” no site masonry, no wet work and no long build wait. As the Kakatiya textile park and Warangal's industrial pockets take shape, that lets a new unit or a contractor set up a project office, an admin room or a gate cabin without holding up the work.

Who buys a container office in Warangal

Warangal is building out around the Kakatiya Mega Textile Park and a growing base of engineering and contractor activity. Most of our enquiries here come from:

  • Textile-park units setting up or expanding, needing a project or admin office
  • Engineering and contractor units needing a supervisor or stores cabin
  • EPC and civil teams needing a temporary site office during construction
  • Plots needing a gate and security office at the entrance

Every unit we supply is an administrative, project or gate cabin â€” a clean, insulated workspace. We do not market these as textile-process, cleanroom or production-line structures.

Where we deliver in and around Warangal

We supply container offices across the main working pockets of Warangal:

  • Kakatiya Mega Textile Park, Shayampet in Geesugonda mandal â€” 506319
  • Hanamkonda commercial and industrial belt â€” 506001
  • Warangal city and project sites â€” 506002
  • Madikonda engineering side â€” served on enquiry

This district runs on textile-park development, engineering and construction contracting â€” buyers who often need a clean office added quickly beside a working site. Share your exact plot and gate access, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Which container office suits your Warangal site

Different jobs call for different cabins. As a guide:

  • A gate or single-desk security point â€” a 10 ft cabin
  • A project, admin or supervisor office â€” a 20 ft cabin, the most common choice
  • A larger office with a meeting or record area â€” a 40 ft cabin, which can be partitioned
  • A unit that will scale in phases â€” a modular container office for textile-park setups

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Warangal is built to the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with a GI sheet roof
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat inside the cabin through the Telangana summer
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, and steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness, wiring load and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price you get is honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your site works. Common additions for Warangal sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, a document-storage area, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Bangalore factory

Warangal is served from our Bangalore factory on South-zone dispatch. It is a longer run: the road route goes via Hyderabad into Warangal â€” roughly 700â€“780 km depending on your plot â€” so we suggest planning 4â€“5 days after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is â‚¹3,000 where applicable; the exact freight and any crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across Telangana and the Andhra coast See our Hyderabad container office deliveries, container offices we supply toward Vijayawada, and our Visakhapatnam container office page.

Documentation for vendor onboarding

Textile-park units and their contractors need clean paperwork for site entry and audits. As a registered Private Limited manufacturer, we issue a proper GST invoice (GSTIN 29ABBCS7101B1ZR) and an e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration. This keeps procurement and audit straightforward.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1â€“2 years on finishing, with a 20â€“25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Warangal

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the delivery distance to Warangal. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote â€” no guesswork, no hidden add-ons.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Warangal?

There is no single fixed price. The cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Warangal site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote the same way for every buyer.

Do you deliver to the Kakatiya Mega Textile Park?

Yes. We dispatch from our Bangalore factory via Hyderabad to the Kakatiya Mega Textile Park at Shayampet (506319), the Hanamkonda belt (506001) and Warangal city (506002) â€” about 700â€“780 km, so we suggest planning 4â€“5 days. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

Which size suits a textile-park admin or supervisor office?

A 20 ft cabin covers most project, admin and supervisor needs, a 10 ft cabin suits a gate or single-desk point, and a 40 ft cabin suits a larger office with a meeting area. Layouts are customised and confirmed at quotation.

Do you provide a GST invoice and e-way bill for vendor onboarding?

Yes. We are a GST-registered Private Limited manufacturer and issue a GST invoice and e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration.
